title.zh: 英伟达发布Nemotron 3.5 Super VL：美国开源第一，跑分落后小米近20分
title.en: 英伟达发布Nemotron 3.5 Super VL：美国开源第一，跑分落后小米近20分

current_state.zh: Nvidia open-sourced Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B-parameter (12B active) long-context multimodal agentic model that tops US open models on Artificial Analysis with 26.5 but trails Chinese rivals on capability benchmarks.
current_state.en: Nvidia open-sourced Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B-parameter (12B active) long-context multimodal agentic model that tops US open models on Artificial Analysis with 26.5 but trails Chinese rivals on capability benchmarks.
